definition.name: Actual accepted timer wait SIGTERM retirement and fresh restart

steps.name: Fetch only the authenticated native producer source object
Reject false timer admission source drift and incomplete producer evidence
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_node_stop tools.tests.test_go_node_stop_positive tools.tests.test_go_node_stop_v7 tools.tests.test_go_node_stop_timer_observer tools.tests.test_java_phase_native_products tools.tests.test_node_startup_observation tools.tests.test_go_node_stop_restart -v

steps.name: Authenticate and restore the distinct V7 native products
Install the existing network-denied compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Authenticate the maintained Go compiler and official generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-node-stop-v7-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go/releases/download/v0.4.3/componentize-go-linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "1061d845f550df5d9477612a7d458a31b1e2b8bdc95823704e42e5064deb0c52  $out/componentize-go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" -C "$out" componentize-go
echo "b41803a645e54845bc8eacef9a69e0eeb8c2c4a9a61964c831ed544e85c137cb  $out/componentize-go" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$out/componentize-go"
test "$("$out/componentize-go" --version)" = 'componentize-go 0.4.3'
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$out/go" --output "$out/go-async"
echo "$out" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$out/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile one current Go fixture and require accepted timer wait before SIGTERM
Retain bounded source timer and shutdown evidence including failures
